title: NEXY autonomous round 9 — real browser E2E gate convergence
scope: DOC-C §15.2 UI critical browser E2E and Next runtime startup on dedicated autonomous branch
inputs_summary: DOC-C UI/test laws, live Next 14.2.35 runtime, PostgreSQL migration proof, GitHub Actions logs.
actions: Diagnosed successive real UI-E2E failures from GitHub job logs rather than static inspection.
Fixed web→packages source resolution and retained backend Node16 source contracts.
Normalized Prisma DATABASE_URL query assembly so existing schema parameters are preserved.
Scoped Node-only bootstrap behind NEXT_RUNTIME=nodejs using a separate instrumentation.node.ts module.
Replaced bootstrap raw SQL occurred_tick assumption with Prisma mapped-field aggregate reads.
Aligned hydration fail-closed test doubles to the new aggregate interface without removing failure assertions.
Re-ran all required gates through final evidence attestation.

claims_proofs.claim: UI E2E previously failed before browser assertions due Next/runtime integration defects.
claims_proofs.proof: Runs 35554993634, 35565359478, 35565578090, 35565888940 logs showed source-resolution, node builtin, DSN, and bootstrap mapping failures.

claims_proofs.claim: Runtime startup and UI critical browser E2E are working at final SHA.
claims_proofs.proof: Run 35566363230: UI critical browser E2E success including migration preparation and browser tests.

claims_proofs.claim: The browser fix is regression-clean across required repository gates.
claims_proofs.proof: Run 35566363230: typecheck, contract, integration, full suite, module-boundary, migration rollback, DOC-C static gate, UI E2E, and evidence attestation all success; deploy skipped.

successes: UI critical flows now execute in a real browser gate.
Next startup no longer traverses Node-only backend code in unsupported runtime.
Prisma DSN and bootstrap tick hydration no longer rely on malformed query/column assumptions.
failures: Initial instrumentation imported backend source with unresolved .js source path.
Intermediate source alias exposed node:crypto bundling mismatch.
Prisma DSN assembly duplicated query delimiter.
Bootstrap raw SQL used a physical column spelling inconsistent with Prisma mapping.
Contract harness temporarily mocked a removed $queryRaw path.
decisions: Use runtime-specific instrumentation per Next contract instead of masking Node schemes.
Use Prisma mapped aggregate API for persisted tick reads.
Keep deploy blocked; UI validation is not DOC-E release approval.
unresolved: F-DOC-C-API-PACK-008 partial canonical API response/session gaps.
F-DOC-C-UI-RBAC-012 recovery UI role/recoverable truth gap.
risks: Current browser suite proves critical flows presently encoded but does not yet cover canonical directive submission or OWNER-only recovery.
limits: No claim that all DOC-C requirements are closed.
rollback: Revert round-9 commits on the dedicated branch if a later verified change regresses startup; never modify main automatically.
next_actions: Repair directive UI canonical request + CSRF/session role context.
Replace noncanonical list calls with canonical ID-based/detail flows.
